text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MC-009","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"title","page":1,"quote":"CYL MTG STUD R01"}],"comment":"The title block identifies the part as a cylindrical mounting stud, which is a shaft-type component typically turned between centres, yet no centre holes are specified on the drawing. Without centre holes the machinist has no defined datum for turning or grinding operations, risking poor concentricity. The designer should add centre hole callouts (e.g., per ISO 6411) at both ends of the stud.","recommended_correction":"Add centre hole specifications to both ends of the stud."}]}
